text.en: What does a generative model learn?

tr: Verinin dağılımını; ondan yeni örnek çeker
en: The data's distribution; it draws new samples from it

explanation.tr: Ayırt edici model yalnızca sınırı öğrenir (00).
explanation.en: A discriminative model only learns the boundary (00).

text.tr: Üretilen örneğin ezber olup olmadığı nasıl denetlenir?
text.en: How is it checked whether a generated sample is memorised?

tr: Eğitim verisindeki en yakın örneğe uzaklıkla
en: With the distance to the nearest training example

explanation.en: A distance of 0 means a copy (00).

text.en: How does sampling by inverse transform work?

tr: Düzgün bir sayıyı dağılımın ters birikimli fonksiyonundan geçirerek
en: By passing a uniform number through the inverse cumulative function
By picking a random sample and rejecting

explanation.en: Rejection sampling is another way (01).

text.tr: Otomatik kodlayıcının üretici olarak zayıflığı nedir?
text.en: What is the autoencoder's weakness as a generator?

tr: Kod uzayı düzensiz; rastgele kod çoğu zaman anlamsız resim verir
en: Its latent space is disorderly; a random code often gives a meaningless image

explanation.en: A clear digit from a random code 32% of the time (02).

text.tr: VAE kayıp fonksiyonunun iki terimi nedir?
text.en: What are the two terms of the VAE loss?

explanation.en: KL pulls the codes to the standard normal (03).

text.en: What is the reparameterization trick?

tr: z = μ + σ·ε; rastgelelik ε'ye taşınır
en: z = μ + σ·ε; the randomness moves into ε

explanation.en: The gradient passes back through the sampling (03).

text.en: Which two networks does a GAN have?

explanation.en: The two are trained in turn (04).

text.en: What is mode collapse?

tr: Üreticinin verinin yalnızca bir kısmını üretmesi
en: The generator producing only part of the data

explanation.en: At learning rate 0.01 two clusters vanished (04).

text.tr: Difüzyon modelinin ağı neyi tahmin eder?
text.en: What does a diffusion model's network predict?

en: The noise added to the point

explanation.en: Training is an ordinary regression (05).

text.en: What is diffusion's price?

tr: Bir örnek için ağı çok kez çalıştırmak
en: Running the network many times for one sample

explanation.en: 100 steps in the section (05).

text.tr: Geri süreçte taze gürültü olmazsa ne olur?
text.en: What happens without fresh noise in the reverse process?

tr: Örnekler kümelerin ortasına toplanır, çeşitlilik kaybolur
en: The samples gather in the middle of the clusters and variety is lost

explanation.en: Distance to the centre 0.064, 0.125 in the data (05).

text.tr: Bir dil modeli sohbette nasıl "cevap verir"?
text.en: How does a language model "answer" in a chat?

tr: Şablondaki asistan işaretinden sonra metni devam ettirerek
en: By continuing the text after the assistant marker in the template
By understanding and researching the question

explanation.en: The model only continues (06).

text.en: What does the finish reason `length` say?

en: The answer was cut at max_tokens and is incomplete

explanation.en: `stop` says the answer finished (06).

text.en: What does temperature 0 give?

explanation.tr: Oyuncak model sıcaklık 0'da da yanlış başkent söyledi (06).
explanation.en: The toy model gave a wrong capital at temperature 0 too (06).

text.tr: Sohbet geçmişi neden her çağrıda gönderilir?
text.en: Why is the conversation history sent in every call?

tr: API durumsuzdur; model önceki çağrıları hatırlamaz
en: The API is stateless; the model does not remember earlier calls

explanation.tr: Toplam token mesaj sayısının karesiyle büyür (07).
explanation.en: The total tokens grow with the square of the messages (07).

text.en: What must fit in the context window?

tr: Giren mesajlar ve istenen cevap uzunluğu birlikte
en: The input messages and the requested answer length together

explanation.en: With 29 + 50 > 60 the request was rejected (07).

text.en: What is the price of trimming the history?

tr: Bilgi kaybı: eski mesajdaki ad unutuldu
en: Losing information: the name in an old message was forgotten

explanation.en: Important facts should be kept separately (07).

text.en: What is hallucination?

tr: Dayanağı olmayan içeriği akıcı biçimde üretmek

explanation.tr: Akıcı ve kendinden emin ama yanlış (08).
explanation.en: Fluent and confident but wrong (08).

text.en: What does a self-consistency gate do?

en: Gives no answer if the answers do not agree

explanation.en: It removed the wrong answers in the toy model (08).

text.en: What does the detail check miss?

tr: Sayı ya da ad içermeyen anlam değişikliğini
en: A change in meaning with no number or name

explanation.en: "store credit" slipped through (08).

text.en: Why are documents split into chunks?

tr: Yalnızca ilgili parçalar gönderilsin; hepsi sığmaz ve pahalı
en: So only relevant chunks are sent; everything does not fit and is expensive

explanation.en: All articles 979, RAG 50 tokens (16).

text.en: Why is overlap put between chunks?

tr: Sınırda bölünen bilgi bir parçada bütün kalsın
en: So a fact split at a border stays whole in one chunk

explanation.en: From 0.42 to 0.50 with 12/4 windows (09).

text.en: Which questions does TF-IDF search miss?

en: Those asking the same thing in other words

explanation.tr: Çare gömme ya da karma arama (09).
explanation.en: The remedy is embedding or hybrid search (09).

text.en: Why are the sources numbered in a RAG prompt?

tr: Cevap kaynak gösterebilsin ve denetlenebilsin diye
en: So the answer can cite and be checked

explanation.en: The number is used in verification (10, 15).

text.tr: Çekimser kalma eşiğini düşürmek ne yapar?
text.en: What does lowering the abstain threshold do?

tr: Doğruyu biraz artırır ama yanlışları çok artırır
en: It raises correct answers a little but wrong ones a lot

explanation.tr: Eşik 1: 17 doğru, 7 yanlış; eşik 2: 15 doğru, 2 yanlış (10).
explanation.en: Threshold 1: 17 correct, 7 wrong; threshold 2: 15, 2 (10).

text.en: What do recall@k and MRR measure?

explanation.en: Retrieval is measured before the answer (11).

text.tr: Bölümde RAG hatalarının çoğu nereden geliyordu?
text.en: Where did most RAG errors come from in the section?

explanation.en: The first job is to improve the search (11).

text.tr: Küçük bir değerlendirme kümesinde neye dikkat edilir?
text.en: What needs care with a small evaluation set?

tr: Birkaç sorunun farkı rastlantı olabilir; aralığa bakılır
en: A difference of a few questions may be chance; look at the interval
A big set is the problem

explanation.en: The interval of a two-question difference was 0–4 (11).

text.tr: Yalnızca yeni veriyle ince ayar neye yol açtı?
text.en: What did fine-tuning on new data alone cause?

explanation.en: Mixing in old data kept it (12).

text.en: What does a reward model learn from?

explanation.en: Bradley–Terry: σ(r(a) − r(b)) (12).

text.en: What is reward hacking?

tr: Ödülün ölçtüğü şeyin artıp istenenin artmaması
en: What the reward measures rising while what is wanted does not

explanation.en: The chosen answers got longer, correctness 78% (12).

text.en: What does LoRA train?

tr: Donuk ağırlığın yanına eklenen iki ince matrisi
en: Two thin matrices added beside the frozen weight

explanation.en: ΔW = AB (13).

text.en: What is LoRA's practical convenience?

tr: Ön eğitimli model değişmez; adaptör takılıp çıkarılır
en: The pre-trained model does not change; the adapter is attached and detached

explanation.tr: Birleştirilince ek hesap maliyeti de yok (13).
explanation.en: Merged, there is no extra compute cost either (13).

text.tr: Grup sütununu silmek önyargıyı neden gidermedi?
text.en: Why did deleting the group column not remove the bias?

en: A proxy variable (the club) gave the group away

text.tr: Hangi adalet ölçüsünün seçileceği kimin kararıdır?
text.en: Whose decision is the choice of fairness measure?

tr: Kurumun; teknik değil, hukuki ve kurumsal bir karar
en: The institution's; an institutional and legal decision, not a technical one

explanation.en: The measures can conflict (14).

text.en: When is personal data masked?

tr: Aramaya, modele ve kayda gitmeden önce
en: Before it goes to the search, the model and the log

explanation.en: The log showed `[EMAIL]` (15).

text.en: What did the verification catch in the capstone system?

en: The period "5 years", which is not in the source

explanation.en: The answer was turned into "not found" (15).

text.tr: İki aşamalı aramanın bitirme sistemindeki etkisi neydi?
text.en: What was the effect of two-stage search in the capstone system?

en: Wrong answers fell from 2 to 0; misses rose from 7 to 9

explanation.en: The price was more tokens (15).

text.tr: RAG yerine bütün belgeleri göndermek neden olmaz?
text.en: Why can all documents not be sent instead of RAG?

tr: Çok daha fazla token (979'a 50) ve büyük derlemler pencereye sığmaz
en: Far more tokens (979 against 50) and large corpora do not fit the window

explanation.en: About a 20-fold difference (16).

text.en: What is the module's common lesson?

tr: İddiayı ölçerek yaz; her bileşeni ayrı ölç
en: Write claims by measuring; measure every component separately

explanation.tr: Birkaç ders kitabı iddiası küçük deneyde tutmadı.
explanation.en: Several textbook claims did not hold in small experiments.
